title: Bangladeshi Counterfeit Currency Image Dataset
author: Afif & Muhaiminul Rashid Shad
description: This dataset contains 1,286 labeled images of Bangladeshi banknotes collected for counterfeit currency detection. It includes both genuine and counterfeit notes of the 500 BDT and 1000 BDT denominations, captured under real-world conditions using standard cameras. Distribution: 500 BDT (829 genuine, 32 counterfeit), 1000 BDT (370 genuine, 55 counterfeit). Intended for image-based counterfeit detection, binary classification, and anomaly detection research.
citation: Afif, Afif; Shad, Muhaiminul Rashid (2026), Bangladeshi Counterfeit Currency Image Dataset, Mendeley Data, V1, doi: 10.17632/gzzz5nrvbn.1
